name: Yakushiji Gaito
source:
Gaito is a student who was suspended for a long time before coming back to school. He is supposed to be [url=http://vndb.org/c1636]Kyouka[/url]'s boyfriend, but she tries to distance herself from him. [spoiler]He tried to cheat on her with [url=http://vndb.org/c1630]Aeka[/url] in the past which led to Kyouka's treatment of Aeka.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yume_Miru_Kusuri:_A_Drug_That_Makes_You_Dream]Wikipedia[/url]]
